subject: [PATCH 2/8] nfsd: make max_blksize a per-namespace setting

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch makes the maximum block size a per-namespace setting in the NFS daemon, rather than a global module-scope variable. This change prevents containerized environments from leaking this value across namespaces and affecting other containers' payload sizes. The patch updates various files to reflect this change, including moving the max_blksize field into struct nfsd_net and updating functions that interact with it.
